geometry_treatment: Retain all fourteen reviewed year-specific redraws and existing approved GIS repairs as provisional maintenance; no retrospective geometry repair.
count_treatment: Retain published PIT/HIC without area or resident-population allocation or new count-incompatibility flags. A corresponding reporting-jurisdiction transfer has not been established.
membership_treatment: Retain existing MSA memberships and frozen numeric boundaries. Individual-CoC exposure and complete-MSA exposure are separate sensitivity estimates.
revisit_condition: Revisit with contrary contemporaneous jurisdiction, shelter or encampment evidence, or if a study specifically depends on pre-2012 Pasadena as an individual CoC.

annotation_defaults.treatment: Retain year-specific source geometry, existing approved repairs, published PIT/HIC and MSA membership; no count allocation or new exclusion.
annotation_defaults.uncertainty: Resident estimates assume uniform population over block land after subtracting Census 2020 water from both decennial geometries; 2010 figures therefore use later water linework. They do not establish shelter/encampment locations or historical PIT/HIC reporting transfers. Percentage denominators are fixed-2020 study population estimates. Source-year note scope includes the baseline and subsequent refinements, not identical outlines throughout that range.

evidence.name: Owner-approved earlier California review and independent Census controls

geometry_annotations.text: CA-600's 2012 redraw is retained as provisional county/municipal GIS alignment. Estimated residents exposed are 1637 removed/1318 added using 2010 blocks, or 2026/1642 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.03982% of the CoC denominator). It combines internal city allocations and cross-MSA county edges. Complete Los Angeles MSA exposure is approximately 295 removed/178 added using an independent 2020 land control (gross 0.00359% of the metro denominator). Later refinements partially replace this linework. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-604's 2012 outline closely matches the Census 2010 Kern County boundary; the 2011 source differs by about 1.505 km2. This is retained as provisional GIS county-line alignment. Estimated residents exposed are 2.34 removed/0.023 added using 2010 blocks, or 0.016/0.022 using 2020 blocks. Later source refinements are retained separately. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-606's 2012 redraw moves closer to Census 2010 Long Beach geometry: symmetric difference falls from about 3.609 to 0.520 km2. Estimated residents exposed are 73 removed/476 added using 2010 blocks, or 230/614 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.18106% of the CoC denominator). Almost all changed area cancels within the complete Los Angeles MSA union; individual exposure is not zero. Later coastal/municipal refinements partially replace this linework. The source outlines are retained as provisional GIS alignment. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

geometry_annotations.summary: CA-607 2012 alignment with pre-existing Pasadena boundary
geometry_annotations.text: CA-607's 2012 outline agrees with both Census 2010 and 2012 Pasadena city geometry within 100 m2; the 2011 source differs by about 1.392 km2. This supports provisional GIS alignment with a pre-existing city boundary, rather than a newly changed city jurisdiction. Estimated residents exposed are 726 removed/386 added using 2010 blocks, or 763/417 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.85099%, net -0.24949% of the CoC denominator). Almost all changed area cancels within the Los Angeles MSA union through neighboring Los Angeles/Glendale assignments. Preserve this larger individual-CoC caveat and revisit for separate pre-2012 Pasadena analysis. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-609's 2012 outline closely matches the Census 2010 San Bernardino County boundary; the 2011 source differs by about 1.569 km2. This is retained as provisional GIS county-line alignment. Estimated residents exposed are 127 removed/61 added using 2010 blocks, or 143/60 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.00931% of the CoC denominator). Some neighboring exchanges cross MSAs; later refinements remain year-specific. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

geometry_annotations.summary: CA-511 2015 county-line update separate from Lodi omission
geometry_annotations.text: CA-511's 2015 redraw is retained as provisional county-line GIS maintenance: about 99.39%/99.80% of removed/added footprints matches changed Census county linework. Estimated residents exposed are 2.93 removed/7.14 added using 2010 blocks, or 35/47 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.01052% of the CoC denominator). Neighboring assignments cross distinct MSAs and are not assumed to cancel within the Stockton site. This decision is separate from the approved 2010–2012 Lodi GIS-omission repair, which is preserved. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

geometry_annotations.summary: CA-510 2018 intermediate linework and 2023 partial return
geometry_annotations.text: CA-510's 2018 redraw is retained as provisional intermediate county/river GIS linework. Estimated residents exposed are 4.19 removed/0.008 added using 2010 blocks, or 4.91/1.20 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.00110% of the CoC denominator). About 0.366 km2 removed in 2018 remains absent through 2022, then returns in 2023 and persists in 2024. This is not a one-year dropout and no automatic restoration is applied. Neighboring exchanges cross distinct MSAs. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-600's 2020 redraw is retained as provisional municipal/county-edge GIS maintenance. Estimated residents exposed are 69 removed/45 added using 2010 blocks, or 236/89 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.00353% of the CoC denominator). Most changed area is absorbed within the complete Los Angeles MSA union, whose independent 2020 control estimates approximately 0.078 residents removed and 0.888 added. This geometry cancellation does not verify consistent CoC-level count reassignment. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-606's 2020 redraw is retained as provisional municipal/coastal GIS maintenance; more than 99.96% of both changed footprints aligns with the difference between Census 2015 and 2020 municipal geometries. Estimated residents exposed are 16 removed/6 added using 2010 blocks, or 46/140 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.03985% of the CoC denominator). Almost all changed area cancels within the complete Los Angeles MSA union. Differing Census offshore-water extents are not interpreted as missing inhabited city land, and later refinements are retained. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-613's 2021 redraw is retained as provisional county-line GIS maintenance; about 97.29%/99.80% of removed/added footprints matches changed Census county linework. Estimated removed residents are 6.61 using 2010 blocks and effectively zero using 2020 blocks; added exposure is effectively zero. These contrasting vintages are sensitivity estimates, not resident moves. The geometry decision does not rehabilitate unobserved 2021 unsheltered counts or change the study's 2021 exclusion. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

geometry_annotations.summary: CA-600 2022 municipal, coastal and county-line update
geometry_annotations.text: CA-600's 2022 redraw is retained as provisional municipal/coastal and county-line GIS maintenance. Estimated residents exposed are 322 removed/155 added using 2010 blocks, or 290/113 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.00438% of the CoC denominator). About 65.8% of removed area is absorbed within the complete Los Angeles MSA union; remaining county-edge exchanges can cross MSAs. The complete-MSA independent 2020 control estimates 146 removed/72 added (gross 0.00166%). This supplements the separately approved Long Beach 2022 caveat. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-604's 2022 redraw is retained as provisional county-line GIS maintenance: about 99.98%/100% of removed/added footprints matches changed Census county linework, and the revised outline matches Census 2023 Kern County within roughly 13 m2. Estimated residents exposed are 8.14 removed/2.54 added using 2010 blocks, or 0.51/38.07 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.00424% of the CoC denominator). Exchanges span distinct MSAs, including Ventura and San Luis Obispo. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-609's 2022 redraw is retained as provisional county-line GIS maintenance: about 99.97%/99.50% of removed/added footprints matches changed Census county linework. Estimated residents exposed are 61 removed/143 added using 2010 blocks, or 89/151 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.01099% of the CoC denominator). Some changes are internal to the Riverside/San Bernardino MSA and others cross distinct MSAs; no universal within-site cancellation is assumed. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.

CA-614's 2022 redraw is retained as provisional county-line GIS maintenance: about 99.99%/100% of removed/added footprints matches changed Census county linework. Estimated residents exposed are 0.718 removed/0.012 added using 2010 blocks, or 0.122/0.027 using 2020 blocks (gross 0.000053% of the CoC denominator). Exchanges with Kern cross distinct MSAs. Differing Census offshore-water extents do not establish missing inhabited jurisdiction. Published PIT/HIC and membership are retained; resident sensitivity does not establish shelter/encampment locations or a count-scope transfer.
